summary:
w180's one commit (75cd7fda; the same change as the reported a4fd9482/06496c00/be7b9477) changes step 4 of skills/formulating-features/SKILL.md to run the old scenario alone with python3 -m pytest, selected by node id or an underscored -k name.
No test or features/ change; tools size is clean; the 4 ruff errors are in files w180 did not touch.
F1 (Important, fix now): the skill says the test name is the title 'lower case with underscores', but pytest-bdd also drops punctuation. 370 of 470 titles have punctuation, and the literal name collects nothing (probe: 0/202 against 1/202 for the real name). The next bullet treats 'not collected' as 'replace or remove', so a passing scenario can be removed, against formulation#r4.
F2 (Minor, observation): -k matches substrings and outline examples; nothing says what to do when more than one test is collected.
Cannot verify: this session's environment deselects every scenario unless --work-item "" is passed. If formulate rounds inherit the same filter, every old scenario reads as not collected.
